text:
maria: Quick intake for cobalt-13b-v2. We need a quantization + calibration plan for gguf (int8 / fp8 hybrids) and a short prioritization note. Link to model: https://internal.models/cobalt-13b-v2 (private). TL;DR: production-facing chat + summarization tests, want a fast path and a cost path.
aj: For evals I suggest 3 suites: (1) chat convs (2) summarization (CNN/Long) (3) instruction-following LLM-eval subset. Keep each small ~1k examples for quick smoke. Also include a handful of adversarial prompts from regressions set.
kevin: Agreed. For calibration, start with a small calibration set (500-2k) to get weightwise stats then a 10k sensitivity run for final numbers. Quick commands we use locally: 
```
# gguf convert + quick calib
python tools/convert_to_gguf.py --src models/cobalt-13b-v2.pt --out /tmp/cobalt-13b-v2.gguf --quant int8
python tools/calibrate.py --gguf /tmp/cobalt-13b-v2.gguf --dataset data/evals/smoke_1k.jsonl --out /tmp/calib_int8.json --seed 42
```
lia: Question: do we gate fp8 hybrid first or int8? For generation quality fp8 tends to preserve fluency, but int8 wins latency/cost. Maybe run int8 fast path first for the chat endpoints and fp8 hybrid as a second pass for summarization jobs.
maria: That makes sense. Prioritization proposal: 1) int8 fast path for chat API (latency-sensitive) — target: <= 1.2x token latency vs fp32 and <= 3% aggregate quality drop on our evals. 2) fp8 hybrid for batch summarization and embeddings-expensive jobs — target: cost <= 0.6x of fp32 and quality drop <=5%. If either fails, fallback to model variant with smaller context length or offload to dedicated pool.
kevin: Add practical thresholds: measure median p95 token latency and avg instruction EM/ROUGE. Example acceptance: EM delta >= -3% and ROUGE-L delta >= -5% is pass for int8 on chat. Also capture repeatability: run 3 seeds for sensitivity checks.
aj: For rollout, canary on 2% traffic with automatic rollback if latency > SLO by 30% or error rate increases >1.5x. We should add a small prompt set for runtime regression checks (5 prompts) and include prompt-level divergence logs.
kevin: I'll schedule the calibration jobs today — planning two runs: int8 quick smoke (1k) and fp8 hybrid sensitivity (10k). Using the standard CI job: 
```
ci run calibration --model cobalt-13b-v2 --profiles int8_quick,fp8_sensitivity --shards 6 --timeout 4h --notify #eng-ml
```
ci-bot: Job queued: calibration #1427 for cobalt-13b-v2. Estimated run time 2.1h.
lia: Nice. Can we also capture a sample of generations (10 per prompt) and compute average logits variance? That helps detect degenerate sampling effects.
maria: Yes capture generations + logits. Also add a small qual check: 20 human-annotated samples across tasks to sanity-check hallucinations.
aj: Who owns follow-up and dashboard? maria: I'll own the intake and the canary rollout plan. kevin: I'll own calib runs and uploading reports. lia: I'll handle the qual annot set.
maria: Great — plan looks good. I'll post a short checklist in the onboarding doc and link results back here when available. :thumbsup:
